Death was an American death metal band formed in Altamonte Springs, Florida, in 1983
Death was an American death metal band formed in Altamonte Springs, Florida, in 1983 by guitarist Chuck Schuldiner
Genres Death metal· progressive metal· technical death metal
Death had a fluctuating lineup, with Schuldiner, aside from a European tour, the sole consistent member. The band disbanded after Schuldiner died of glioma and pneumonia in December 2001
Formed out of what would become the Florida death metal scene, Death is considered a pioneering death metal band.
